title: Hamant et al. (2008) Science & Heisler et al. (2010) PLoS Biol — Pressurized Shell Principal Stress, Cortical Microtubule & PIN1 Polarity Co-Alignment in Arabidopsis Shoot Apical Meristem
organism: Arabidopsis thaliana (shoot apical meristem L1 epidermis & floral primordia)

primary_sources.role: Pressurized thin-shell principal stress tensor (spherical dome vs cylindrical flank vs saddle primordium boundary crease), cortical microtubule (CMT) alignment along maximal principal tensile stress e_1, anisotropic Lockhart cell wall yielding, laser ablation, lateral compression, and oryzalin depolymerization experiments

Quantitative co-alignment of PIN1 auxin efflux carrier polarity and cortical microtubule orientation across L1 meristem cells under normal growth, laser ablation, and isoxaben/mechanical perturbations
Up-the-gradient PIN1 polarization and active auxin transport on a cellular shoot apical meristem dome generating 137.5 deg golden-angle phyllotactic primordia

primary_sources.citation: Mirabet et al. (2012) PLoS Comput. Biol. 8(2):e1002389
primary_sources.role: Phyllotactic divergence angle robustness and M-shaped permutation noise on the growing shoot apical meristem

secondary_papers_pass3.used_for: Mechanical division rule (new wall along maximal tension) for L1/L2 anticlinal planes; shoot-apex statistics: 65-77% of all division planes are the shortest (Besson-Dumais class 1) plane, 81% of 829 divisions are symmetric (smaller daughter 40-50% of mother), epidermis thickness ~5 um, boundary region enriched in long planes
Gibbs-measure division rule P_i = exp(-beta l_i / rho) / Z with universal beta = 20.6 (geometric ablation rule and L3 corpus rule extrapolated to relative plane areas)
L1 and L2 are single clonal layers maintained by anticlinal divisions; the corpus (L3) divides in periclinal as well as anticlinal planes (qualitative, no fraction reported)

secondary_papers_pass3.citation: Kutschera & Niklas (2007) Journal of Plant Physiology 164(11):1395-1409
secondary_papers_pass3.used_for: Epidermal-growth-control / tensile-skin theory: the thick outer epidermal walls are the load-bearing layer, motivating the k_L1 / k_inner > 1 in-plane stiffness ratio of the multilayer mesh (Lean Law 4 load sharing)

multilayer_mesh_parameters_pass3.note: Reduced 3D multi-layered Voronoi cell-centre mesh (NOT a finite-element vertex model). Model units: pressure = 1, lengths in um, spring stiffness per unit face area. All values below are modelling assumptions unless a source is given.
multilayer_mesh_parameters_pass3.epidermal_thickness_source: Louveaux et al. (2016) Fig. S2A: shoot apex epidermis almost constant thickness of around 5 um
multilayer_mesh_parameters_pass3.division_volume_threshold: V >= 2 V_birth (V_birth = V_eq * U(0.55, 1.0) for founder cells, V_mother / 2 for daughters)

division_rules.L1_L2_default: mechanical (Louveaux 2016): plane normal n_s x e_1 of tissue virial + cell-autonomous turgor tension P w_perp / (2 h)
division_rules.L1_L2_ablation: geometric (Besson & Dumais 2011): Gibbs over 12 anticlinal candidate planes, beta = 20.6
division_rules.L3: 3D Gibbs over the three principal axes of the polyhedron, beta = 20.6 on relative plane area (extrapolation)

division_plane_benchmarks.shortest_plane_source: Louveaux et al. (2016) PNAS 113:E4294 (65-77% of all planes; 68-81% of predicted planes)
division_plane_benchmarks.symmetric_division_source: Louveaux et al. (2016) Fig. S2E (n = 829; smaller daughter 40-50% of mother)
division_plane_benchmarks.l1_l2_anticlinal_source: Reddy et al. (2004) Development 131:4225; Louveaux et al. (2016) Fig. S2A
division_plane_benchmarks.l3_periclinal_note: Reddy et al. (2004): corpus divides in periclinal as well as anticlinal planes; no quantitative fraction reported

multilayer_mesh_parameters_pass3.membrane_law_comparison: A_sigma(r) = (1 - q) / (3 - q), q = kappa_m / kappa_theta = 1 / (1 + r^2 / R^2) on the paraboloid z = -r^2/(2R) (Hamant 2008 SOM thin-shell balance; Lean Law 1)

specimen_metadata.author: Kingfiser (Wikimedia Commons)
specimen_metadata.description: Toluidine-blue stained longitudinal section of Arabidopsis thaliana shoot apical meristem (SAM) central dome, L1/L2 tunica layers, L3 corpus, and adjacent lateral primordium separated by a negative-Gaussian-curvature saddle boundary crease.
